raw.query: SELECT run_id, pool, sla_metric, p50_ms, p90_ms, p99_ms, n_requests FROM provenance.v_pool_latency WHERE run_id IN ('sweeps:vision_head2k_s1','sweeps:llm_head2k')
raw.observed: parallel (sweeps:vision_head2k_s1, vision-converter run): encoder_delay p50/p90/p99 = 8.876 / 52.255 / 199.110. The only archived sequential-era head run (sweeps:llm_head2k) is a LANGUAGE-ISOLATION run: 8.536 / 54.621 / 200.207 — differs at every percentile (~1 ms at p99), NOT identical to three decimals. No same-version --sequential-chunks head2k rerun exists in v_pool_latency.
raw.claimed: steady-head percentiles identical to three decimals between chunk-parallel and sequential dispatch
raw.evidence: claim's only backing compares a vision-converter run against a language-isolation run (non-comparable populations/experiments); the proper chunk-parallel-vs-sequential head2k pair does not exist in the DB, so the 'three decimals' equality is unsubstantiated and the only proxy contradicts it (~1 ms off at every percentile).
raw.fix: Soften 'identical to three decimals' to 'agree to within ~1 ms' and add a same-version --sequential-chunks head2k rerun (or cite the actual regression check that shows equality); do not compare a vision-converter run against a language-isolation run.
